item.title: Forging Success with Financing
item.description: Veteran contractor-turned finance pro Jonathan Sagner draws from his experience in both worlds to boost roofing sales in today’s high-priced environment.

item.title: The Home Depot to Launch Real-Time Tracking for Pro Deliveries
item.description: The Home Depot plans a real-time delivery tracker for large building materials, giving professional contractors minute-by-minute updates on truck locations and delivery timing.

item.title: Polyglass Roofing Products Meet IBHS FORTIFIED Roof Standard
item.description: Polyglass roofing membranes and underlayments now qualify for use in IBHS FORTIFIED Roof projects designed to improve wind and weather resistance.

item.title: Home Depot lanzará seguimiento en tiempo real para entregas a profesionales
item.description: Home Depot planea lanzar seguimiento de entregas en tiempo real para materiales de construcción antes de finalizar el primer trimestre, para ayudar a contratistas a gestionar mejor las obras.

item.title: TAMKO Launches HailGuard Shingles With Hail Warranty
item.description: TAMKO introduces HailGuard shingles with impact technology, Class 4 rating, and a hail warranty.

item.title: Negative Review Scams: How Roofing Contractors are Fighting Back
item.description: Fake Google reviews and ransom demands are targeting roofing contractors nationwide. Here’s how companies are fighting back — and what you should do.

item.title: Owens Corning Leader MaryBeth Tran Wins 2026 STEP Ahead Award
item.description: MaryBeth Tran, site leader at Owens Corning’s Compton, Calif., roofing plant, earns a national 2026 STEP Ahead Award for leadership and developing future manufacturing talent.

item.title: Taller de Marcos Sierra reúne a 540 contratistas y recauda $30,000
item.description: Un taller para contratistas liderado por Marcos Sierra reunió a 540 asistentes y recaudó más de $30,000 para Humane Borders, destacando implementación, márgenes y crecimiento empresarial disciplinado.

item.title: Johns Manville ofrece recursos de techado en español
item.description: Johns Manville lanzó un centro de recursos en español para techadores comerciales, ofreciendo guías, hojas de datos de seguridad (SDS) y videos para ayudar a las cuadrillas a acceder a información técnica en el lugar de trabajo.

item.title: Mutual Success Workshop Draws 540 Contractors to N.J.
item.description: A contractor workshop led by Marcos Sierra, president of Marcos Sierra Roofing & Solar, drew 540 attendees and raised over $30,000 for Humane Borders while emphasizing implementation, margins and disciplined business growth.
